observations.text: Water is leaking from the P-trap joint under the kitchen sink.

title: Leaking sink P-trap
explanation: It appears the P-trap under your sink is leaking, likely due to a loose connection or a worn-out washer. The plumber will inspect the pipe, tighten the joints, or replace the P-trap if damaged. In the meantime, please avoid using the sink and place a bucket underneath to catch any remaining water.
